body:
NODE_NUMBER now distinguishes whole-number literals (int) from decimal ones (double), and a new loop_body_int_safe() check keeps a loop binding's declared type consistent with every real recur update (via the real emit_expr type inference, not a hand-rolled subset -- a first draft using a narrow +/-/* recognizer regressed set.prn's fnv1a-hash, caught and fixed). Verified against base4/vector.prn's dot and base4/matrix.prn's matmul, both previously documented as confirmed-buggy; both tests updated to assert the real, correct values. array.prn's own matmul/transpose remain separately unverified -- a different, unrelated bug in the [i j] index-Vec-literal path, honestly not claimed fixed. make test: 347/347, every other real test target re-run clean. Commits 5facc65/3b04bf9.

⚓ ☃
title: Fixed the real, cross-cutting loop-variable I32 boxing bug
